_comment: arc_flow's start (the whole-arc proof): Act II COMPLETE (2 classes: warrior 2 + diplomat 1; 3 completed quests the_errand/missing_crate/cisterns), standing at the inn bed (2,6 facing DOWN onto the bed at 2,7), met_relc banked.
